in_marathi.name: Lakshmikant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lakshmi's (Goddess of Wealth) form
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakshmikant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lakshmikant is a Sanskrit name derived from Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and fortune. The name Lakshmikant signifies that the person is a manifestation of Lakshmi and carries her blessings.
